about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Explaining simply is a skill you can learn.
We explain things every day. When it goes badly, people nod anyway, then do the wrong thing.
Good explainers aren't born with a gift. They find out what the other person already knows, use examples and comparisons, and avoid insider words.
They give one idea at a time, and they check that it landed.
This guide walks through those habits, with tips for explaining to children, older relatives, and people facing health news.
Think of one thing you need to explain this week, such as a new rota or a bill. Keep it in mind as you read the cards.
